status: Complete incremental measurements; cumulative final campaigns remain held.

scope.primary: QEMU spawn through full shared pre-request serial-token arrival, including startup and stock Linux boot.
scope.timing_environment: Root-team quiet window: coordinated team builds, profiles and other VMs were held; whole-host idleness is not established.
scope.trial_policy: Three alternating pairs per stage, CPU96/host97, ordinary local caches, no instrumentation, retries, replacements or ignored outliers.
scope.position_balance: Before/after, after/before, before/after: before is first in two rounds and after first in one; this is alternating but not evenly position-balanced.
scope.native: All eighteen fresh-guest native witness fields exact across all twelve trials and retained earlier references; authenticated seq2/request+1/logical+50 and native paused acknowledgement.
scope.capture: Full256MiB RAM, registers, timer and actual grant list captured outside primary; stopped semantic tuple rechecked after RAM save.
scope.cpu_accounting: CPU counters are sampled after native paused acknowledgement, not exactly at common serial-token receipt.
scope.device_projection: Schema validation only; not a fingerprint of full modeled device-state values.
scope.statistics: Both effects are mixed and inconclusive. No uncertainty bound, general workload speed claim or sum of incremental percentages.
scope.rx_stack: Static outer production wrapper stack reservation23592→176 bytes and five page probes→zero; not measured VM RSS or total process memory reduction.

all_raw_results.scope:
Compare ordinary TCG and Sim through the same complete serial milestone.

All rows boot identical stock kernel and initramfs bytes. The primary interval
starts before QEMU spawn and ends when the common socket reader receives the
complete pre-request token. It includes emulator startup, QMP setup and boot;
protocol allocation and post-marker diagnostics are outside the interval.

Ordinary TCG without icount, ordinary TCG with 1 ns per instruction, and Sim
with 50 ps per instruction use different execution contracts. Their same-workload
boot latency comparison is not a measurement of equal-instruction overhead.
Sim's authenticated native stop, full RAM, registers and timer witness are
qualified separately after the common marker. Stock post-marker QMP stops are
not exact token coordinates. CPU accounting endpoints are recorded per row.

Build the new guest and driver with the AOS phase2.tcgLinuxSerialGuest and
phase2.tcgLinuxSerialPerformanceDriver targets using local builders. Pass each
row explicitly as --row LABEL MODE QEMU_BINARY PLUGIN_OR_DASH. Modes are tcg,
tcg-icount and sim; ordinary TCG takes '-' for the plugin. No plugins are loaded
in ordinary TCG rows, even when the emulator supports them. Repeated rounds
rotate row positions and then reverse the rotations. Every start, exit, stream,
raw result and failed attempt is retained; no failed trial is retried or replaced.
